inlines.v: ECSTAT'IC ECSTAT'ICAL, adjective Arresting the mind; suspending the senses; entrancing. In pensive trance, and anguish, and ecstatic fit. 1. Rapturous; transporting; ravishing; delightful beyond measure; as ecstatic bliss or joy. 2. Tending to external objects. [Not used.]
